description: This file defines an action for duplicating selected elements in an Excalidraw-like drawing application, including UI components and logic for handling duplication, selection, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Performs duplication of selected elements, handling special cases like linear element editing, and updates application state accordingly.

methods.name: keyTest
methods.description: Checks if the keyboard event matches the duplication shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd + D).

methods.name: PanelComponent
methods.description: Renders a UI button for duplication, with mobile responsiveness and disabled state based on selection.
